abstract.t: This document defines a new EVPN route type for advertising multicast source-prefix reachability information within an EVPN network. The route enables Reverse Path Forwarding (RPF) resolution for multicast traffic independently of the unicast routing topology, addressing the operational requirement for non-congruent unicast and multicast forwarding paths in tenant multicast deployments. The proposed route type allows an EVPN PE to advertise source-prefix reachability for multicast RPF, learned through a multicast-specific routing protocol (e.g., BGP using the Multicast Address Family) or configured locally through policy or static multicast routes.
